## Global Delivery Model

Mints Global delivers all services remotely to international clients and on-site within MENA and Europe. The agency operates a timezone-aware model:

- **MENA clients (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Egypt):** Primary office hours, on-site available within 24 hours.
- **European clients (Germany, UK, France, Netherlands, Scandinavia):** Adjusted working hours (our morning overlaps their afternoon). On-site deployment available via European partner network. Native German-language communication available.
- **North American clients:** Asynchronous model with same-day turnaround. Dedicated project managers aligned to EST/PST where required.
- **Asia-Pacific clients (India, Singapore, Australia):** Our late afternoon aligns with their morning. Full digital collaboration via Slack, Jira, and Microsoft Teams.

All international software and cyber security engagements include:
- Formal Statements of Work (SoW) with international jurisdiction clauses
- Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) for EU clients under GDPR Article 28
- Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for data transfers from EU to UAE
- Invoicing in client's preferred currency (USD, EUR, GBP, AED)
- VAT/tax invoices compliant with UAE FTA and EU VAT requirements

### 1.1 SEO Optimization

**URL:** https://mintsglobal.ae/digital-marketing/seo  
**Tags:** Technical SEO · Bilingual SEO · Link Building · Core Web Vitals · International SEO  

**Description:** Dominate search rankings across any geography with data-driven, technically precise SEO. Mints Global specialises in multilingual SEO (Arabic, English, German), international SEO architecture (hreflang, geo-targeting, multiregional sitemaps), and high-authority link building for competitive global markets.

**Who This Is For:** Businesses targeting customers in the UAE, GCC, Europe, or any English-speaking global market. Brands needing bilingual Arabic/English SEO. Companies with declining rankings after Google core updates. New websites needing a solid SEO foundation before launch.

**Core Capabilities:**
- Technical SEO & Audits — crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data (JSON-LD), canonical management
- On-Page & Content Strategy — keyword clustering, content gap analysis, E-E-A-T optimisation, semantic HTML
- Authority Link Building — editorial placements, digital PR campaigns, white-hat acquisition in target markets
- International SEO — hreflang implementation, country-specific subdirectory or subdomain architecture, multiregional keyword research
- Bilingual SEO (Arabic/English) — dual-language keyword research, RTL content optimisation, Arabic SERP analysis
- Local SEO (any market) — Google Business Profile optimisation, citation building, map pack rankings

**FAQs:**
- Q: How long does SEO take to show results?
  A: Organic SEO typically takes 3–6 months to produce meaningful ranking improvements depending on domain authority and competitive density. Technical fixes and on-page changes can show measurable improvements within 4–8 weeks. We provide transparent monthly reporting so progress is always visible.
- Q: Do you do SEO for markets outside the Middle East?
  A: Yes. We manage SEO campaigns for clients targeting UK, Germany, USA, Australia, India, and other global markets. International SEO — including hreflang, geo-targeting, and market-specific keyword research — is a core speciality.
- Q: Do you do Arabic SEO?
  A: Yes. We specialise in bilingual Arabic/English SEO covering keyword research in both languages, Arabic content creation, RTL technical implementation, and dual-language hreflang configurations.
- Q: Do you handle content creation as part of SEO?
  A: Yes. Content strategy and production (blog posts, landing pages, product descriptions) is integrated into our SEO service. We can produce content in English, Arabic, and German.

### 1.2 Performance Marketing

**URL:** https://mintsglobal.ae/digital-marketing/performance-marketing  
**Tags:** Google Ads · Meta Ads · LinkedIn · TikTok Ads · Programmatic · ROAS · PPC · CPA  

**Description:** Scale revenue globally with highly targeted, data-driven paid media campaigns. We engineer campaigns around your Target CPA or ROAS across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and programmatic networks — in any market, in any language.

**Who This Is For:** E-commerce brands scaling beyond their home market. B2B companies generating leads globally. Startups with ad spend ready to deploy and needing specialist management. Any business currently running ads but not achieving target ROAS.

**Core Capabilities:**
- Google Ads (PPC) — search, shopping, display, YouTube, and Performance Max campaigns across all markets and languages
- Meta Advertising — Facebook and Instagram campaigns for consumer brands and B2B lead generation globally
- LinkedIn Ads — B2B lead generation targeting by job title, seniority, industry, and company size in any country
- TikTok Ads — short-form video ad campaigns for consumer brands targeting Gen Z and Millennial audiences
- Programmatic Display — audience-targeted banner and video campaigns across the open web via DSPs
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) — landing page A/B testing, checkout flow analysis, heatmaps, session recordings
- Retargeting Campaigns — re-engagement of website visitors and abandoned cart users across all platforms
- Data & Analytics — full-funnel attribution via Google Tag Manager, GA4, and platform pixels

**Pricing Context:** Minimum recommended media spend: USD $3,000–$5,000/month. Agency management fee is separate and scales with spend volume.  
**Result Timeline:** Traffic from day one of campaign launch. Full campaign optimisation data typically available after 2–4 weeks.

**FAQs:**
- Q: Do you guarantee results?
  A: We guarantee full transparency, daily optimisation, and an unwavering commitment to your Target CPA or ROAS. Absolute outcome guarantees are not made by any honest agency — market variables (seasonality, competition, economic conditions) affect results.
- Q: Can you run ads in languages other than English?
  A: Yes. We run campaigns in Arabic, German, French, Spanish, and other languages through our network of native language specialists and copywriters.
- Q: How do you track conversions accurately?
  A: Via Google Tag Manager, GA4, platform pixels (Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, TikTok Pixel), and where required, server-side tracking for GDPR-compliant environments.
- Q: What is the minimum ad budget you recommend?
  A: USD $3,000–$5,000/month in media spend to gather sufficient data for meaningful optimisation. Below this, results are statistically unreliable.

**FAQs:**
- Q: Should I choose Native or Cross-Platform?
  A: Cross-platform (React Native/Flutter) is ideal if you need faster time-to-market and lower initial budget for a standard utility or social app. Native is recommended for complex 3D graphics, heavy device hardware integration, or maximum performance requirements.
- Q: How long does it take to build an app?
  A: A standard MVP typically takes 3–4 months. Complex applications with many integrations and screens take 6–12 months. A detailed timeline is provided after the discovery and scoping phase.
- Q: Will you help with App Store and Play Store submission?
  A: Yes. Submission is fully included — provisioning profiles, certificates, app review compliance, metadata, and screenshots.
- Q: Do you support the app after launch?
  A: Yes. We offer SLA-based post-launch support covering crash monitoring, API updates, OS compatibility, and bug fixes.

### 3.1 Offensive Security

**URL:** https://mintsglobal.ae/cyber-security/offensive-security  
**Tags:** Penetration Testing · Red Teaming · CREST · OSCP · Vulnerability Assessment · Social Engineering · Cloud Pentesting  

**Description:** Identify and exploit vulnerabilities before real adversaries do. CREST-aligned penetration testing, multi-stage red team simulations, and continuous vulnerability management across your entire global attack surface.

**Who This Is For:** Any organisation that stores sensitive data, processes payments, or runs critical infrastructure. Companies preparing for ISO 27001 or SOC 2 certification. Businesses after a security incident who need to verify re-hardened defences.

**Core Capabilities:**
- Network Penetration Testing — external and internal infrastructure testing against real-world attack vectors including lateral movement and privilege escalation
- Web & Mobile Application Pentesting — OWASP Top 10, authentication bypass, IDOR, injection flaws, business logic errors
- Red Team Simulations — multi-stage adversarial campaigns targeting people (phishing), processes, and technology simultaneously
- Social Engineering — phishing simulations, vishing, pretexting, and physical access attempts
- Cloud Security Assessments — AWS, Azure, and GCP configuration exploitation including IAM abuse, S3 exposure, and serverless attack surfaces
- Vulnerability Management — continuous automated scanning, CVSS-based prioritisation, and remediation tracking

**Deliverables:** Executive summary (non-technical) + Full technical report with proof-of-concept screenshots + Severity-rated findings with step-by-step remediation guidance + Retesting to verify fixes.

**FAQs:**
- Q: What is the difference between a vulnerability assessment and a penetration test?
  A: A vulnerability assessment is an automated scan that identifies known weaknesses across your systems. A penetration test goes much further — our engineers manually exploit those vulnerabilities, chain them together, and simulate the actual impact a real attacker would achieve, including lateral movement and data exfiltration.
- Q: Will penetration testing disrupt our live systems?
  A: No. We coordinate closely with your team, schedule testing during low-traffic windows where required, and throttle tools to prevent Denial of Service conditions. Our methodology prioritises safe exploitation over disruption.
- Q: What do we receive at the end of a penetration test?
  A: A comprehensive report including an executive summary, a full technical breakdown of every vulnerability found, proof-of-concept screenshots or videos, CVSS risk scores, and step-by-step remediation guidance. Free re-test of critical findings is included.
- Q: How often should we conduct penetration tests?
  A: Industry best practice is annually at minimum, or after any significant infrastructure change, new application launch, or major acquisition.
- Q: Do you test cloud environments like AWS and Azure?
  A: Yes. Cloud penetration testing is a core speciality — including IAM privilege escalation, S3/Blob storage exposure, container breakout, serverless function abuse, and SSRF to metadata service attacks.

---

**Core Capabilities:**
- Emergency Breach Response — immediate triage, containment, and isolation of active incidents to stop attacker progression
- Ransomware Negotiation & Recovery — threat actor communication, ransom analysis, decryption facilitation, and data recovery
- Digital Forensics (DFIR) — disk imaging, volatile memory analysis, network traffic reconstruction, and legally defensible chain of custody
- Malware Reverse Engineering — binary decompilation, behavioural analysis, C2 identification, and threat actor attribution
- Post-Incident Reporting — full attack timeline reconstruction, root cause analysis, and board-ready executive report
- Compromise Assessments — proactive hunt to determine if you have already been breached without knowing

**Retainer Model:** Pre-purchase response hours for priority access, guaranteed SLAs, and a reduced effective hourly rate. Unused retainer hours redirect to proactive services (tabletop exercises, purple teaming, compromise assessments).

**FAQs:**
- Q: We think we are being breached right now. What do we do?
  A: Call +971 502943916 immediately. Critically: do NOT power off or reboot affected machines (this destroys RAM-resident forensic evidence). Physically disconnect affected machines from the network (unplug ethernet / disable Wi-Fi). Do not communicate about the breach via email — assume the attacker has email access.
- Q: Do you offer guaranteed SLAs?
  A: Yes. Retainer clients receive guaranteed remote response within 1 hour and on-site MENA response within 24 hours. European on-site is within 48 hours via our partner deployment network.
- Q: Can you guarantee full recovery from ransomware?
  A: No reputable firm can guarantee 100% recovery without viable offline backups. We maximise recovery chances through expert negotiation, encryption flaw identification, and forensic-driven restoration — and we are transparent about realistic outcomes from the outset.
- Q: How does a retainer work?
  A: You pre-purchase a block of incident response hours. This ensures our team is pre-briefed on your environment and ready to deploy instantly. Hours unused in incident response can be repurposed for proactive services at no extra cost.

### 3.3 Managed Advisory / vCISO

**URL:** https://mintsglobal.ae/cyber-security/managed-advisory  
**Tags:** vCISO · Virtual CISO · Managed SOC · MDR · SIEM · SOAR · Security Architecture · Third-Party Risk  

**Description:** Enterprise-grade security leadership and 24/7 managed detection and response — without enterprise headcount costs. Our vCISO and SOC services act as your fully externalised security department.

**Core Capabilities:**
- Virtual CISO (vCISO) — fractional CISO providing board reporting, security programme ownership, and strategic risk management
- Managed SOC / MDR — 24/7/365 security operations centre powered by SIEM and SOAR, providing continuous threat detection, triage, and response
- Security Architecture Review — independent assessment of your infrastructure, tooling, and security controls against industry frameworks
- Third-Party Risk Management — evaluating and continuously monitoring the security posture of suppliers and partners
- Security Awareness Training — phishing simulations, interactive e-learning, and security culture development programmes
- M&A Cyber Due Diligence — pre-acquisition security risk assessments to quantify inherited cyber exposure

**FAQs:**
- Q: Why hire a vCISO instead of a full-time CISO?
  A: A senior full-time CISO costs USD $200,000–$350,000/year globally. A vCISO delivers the same strategic security leadership at 10–30% of that cost — ideal for organisations that need boardroom-level security expertise but not a full-time executive headcount.
- Q: Does your SOC operate 24/7?
  A: Yes. Our Managed Detection and Response (MDR) service provides true follow-the-sun 24/7/365 coverage powered by state-of-the-art SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) and SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation and Response) platforms.
- Q: Are you vendor-agnostic?
  A: Yes. Mints Global is entirely vendor-agnostic. We recommend tools strictly on merit for your environment — not based on reseller relationships or margin incentives.
- Q: How do you communicate security risk to our board?
  A: Our vCISO team specialises in translating highly technical cyber risks into business-focused language. Board reporting covers risk exposure in financial terms, ROI of security investments, and compliance posture — without technical jargon.

### 3.4 Compliance & GRC

**URL:** https://mintsglobal.ae/cyber-security/compliance-grc  
**Tags:** ISO 27001 · GDPR · DSGVO · NIS2 · NESA · PDPL · PCI-DSS · SOC 2 · Risk Assessment · DPO  

**Description:** End-to-end compliance advisory across all major international cyber security and data protection frameworks. Gap assessment, risk treatment, policy development, and certification readiness — for any regulatory environment globally.

**Frameworks Covered:**

| Framework | Jurisdiction | Who It Applies To |
|---|---|---|
| ISO/IEC 27001 | International | Any organisation seeking ISMS certification |
| NESA / ISR | UAE | UAE critical information infrastructure operators |
| PDPL | UAE | Any entity processing UAE residents' personal data |
| GDPR | European Union | Any entity processing EU residents' data, regardless of location |
| DSGVO | Germany | German implementation of GDPR |
| UK GDPR | United Kingdom | Any entity processing UK residents' data post-Brexit |
| NIS2 Directive | European Union | Critical infrastructure and essential/important entities in EU |
| PCI-DSS | Global | Any entity that processes, stores, or transmits payment card data |
| SOC 2 Type II | USA / Global | SaaS and cloud service providers serving US enterprise clients |
| ISA/IEC 62443 | Global | Industrial automation and operational technology environments |

**Core Capabilities:**
- ISO 27001 Readiness — gap assessment, risk treatment plan, Statement of Applicability (SoA), policy suite, and Stage 1/2 audit preparation
- GDPR & Data Privacy — data mapping (ROPA), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA), DPO advisory, and consent framework design
- UAE Regulations (NESA / PDPL) — control mapping, policy alignment, and regulator-ready documentation for UAE-regulated entities
- NIS2 Directive Alignment — incident reporting procedures, supply chain security controls, and governance framework for EU essential/important entities
- Risk Assessments — qualitative and quantitative risk analysis aligned to ISO 31000, with risk register and treatment plan
- Policy & Procedure Drafting — complete information security policy suites, acceptable use, BYOD, remote working, and incident response plans

**FAQs:**
- Q: Do you provide the ISO 27001 certificate?
  A: No. Certification is issued exclusively by independent accredited certification bodies (CBs). We prepare your organisation to pass the Stage 1 and Stage 2 audits. The majority of our clients achieve certification on their first attempt.
- Q: Does GDPR apply to my business outside of Europe?
  A: Yes. GDPR has extraterritorial reach — if you offer goods/services to EU residents, or monitor their behaviour (e.g., tracking cookies on a website accessible to EU users), you are legally required to comply regardless of where your company is based.
- Q: How long does ISO 27001 implementation take?
  A: 6–9 months for a mid-sized organisation starting from a low security baseline. Organisations with existing security controls in place can achieve readiness faster.
- Q: How much involvement will this require from our internal IT team?
  A: We handle the heavy lifting — documentation, gap analysis, risk registers, and roadmapping. We require collaboration with your IT team to verify technical control implementation, but we structure our engagement to minimise business disruption.

### 3.5 Cloud Security

**URL:** https://mintsglobal.ae/cyber-security/cloud-security  
**Tags:** AWS Security · Azure Security · GCP Security · CSPM · IAM · DevSecOps · Kubernetes · Container Security  

**Description:** Audit, harden, and continuously monitor your AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud environments against misconfiguration, privilege abuse, and data exposure risks. From one-time assessments to embedded DevSecOps programmes.

**Core Capabilities:**
- Cloud Security Assessments — comprehensive review against CIS Benchmarks, NIST SP 800-53, and CSA Cloud Controls Matrix
- Identity & Access Management (IAM) — privilege analysis, least-privilege enforcement, and zero-trust access architecture
- Container & Kubernetes Security — Docker hardening, Kubernetes RBAC, Pod Security Standards, and runtime threat detection
- Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) — continuous automated policy monitoring and misconfiguration alerting
- DevSecOps Integration — SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning embedded into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)
- Data Protection & Encryption — data classification, KMS/HSM key management, data loss prevention (DLP), and encryption at rest/in transit

**FAQs:**
- Q: Isn't the cloud provider responsible for security?
  A: No. Cloud providers operate a Shared Responsibility Model — they secure the physical data centres and underlying infrastructure, but YOU are responsible for securing your data, applications, configurations, and access controls. The vast majority of cloud breaches are caused by customer-side misconfiguration, not provider failure.
- Q: Do you support multi-cloud environments?
  A: Yes. Our engineers are certified across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform, including complex hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.
- Q: What is CSPM and do I need it?
  A: CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Management) is a class of automated tools that continuously monitor your cloud environment and alert you to misconfigurations (like an accidentally public S3 bucket or overpermissive IAM role) in real time. Any organisation using cloud infrastructure at meaningful scale needs it.
- Q: Can you remediate the issues you find, not just report them?
  A: Yes. Post-assessment, our cloud engineers implement fixes, rewrite insecure Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep), and establish preventive guardrails via Service Control Policies (AWS) or Azure Policy.

---

### 3.6 OT / IoT Security

**URL:** https://mintsglobal.ae/cyber-security/ot-iot-security  
**Tags:** OT Security · ICS · SCADA · Industrial Cybersecurity · IoT · IEC 62443 · Firmware Analysis · IT/OT Segmentation  

**Description:** Protecting critical infrastructure, industrial control systems, and connected devices from cyber-physical attack. Specialised non-disruptive methodology for live operational environments.

**Who This Is For:** Energy, utilities, oil & gas, manufacturing, building management, and transportation operators. IoT device manufacturers needing firmware security assessments. Any organisation with SCADA, ICS, or legacy OT networks.

**Core Capabilities:**
- OT Security Posture Assessments — evaluating ICS/SCADA environments against ISA/IEC 62443 without disrupting production
- IT/OT Network Segmentation — designing and implementing zones and conduits architecture to prevent IT-to-OT lateral movement
- IoT Device Penetration Testing — firmware extraction, binary analysis, protocol fuzzing, and physical interface testing
- Asset Discovery & Visibility — passive and active discovery of all connected OT/IoT assets including legacy PLCs and unmanaged devices
- Industrial Incident Response — specialised containment and recovery for OT environments with production continuity as the primary constraint
- OT Security Governance — OT-specific security policies, risk registers, patch management strategies, and supply chain vendor controls

**FAQs:**
- Q: How is OT security different from standard IT security?
  A: In IT, the priority hierarchy is Confidentiality → Integrity → Availability. In OT, it is inverted — Safety and Availability dominate. A scanning tool that works safely in IT can crash a fragile legacy PLC and cause a plant shutdown. OT security demands highly specialised, passive methodologies and deep domain expertise.
- Q: Can you test our operational systems while they are running in production?
  A: Yes, using passive-only techniques. We primarily utilise network traffic analysis and passive asset discovery. Active testing is conducted on digital twins, duplicate testing environments, or during strictly controlled maintenance windows — never on live production without your explicit confirmation.
- Q: What framework do you follow for OT security?
  A: Our methodology is aligned to ISA/IEC 62443 (the global consensus standard for industrial cybersecurity), supplemented by NIST SP 800-82, the MITRE ATT&CK for ICS framework, and sector-specific guidance (NERC CIP for energy, IAEA for nuclear-adjacent).
- Q: Do you assess firmware on connected IoT devices?
  A: Yes. For IoT manufacturers, we extract firmware, decompile binaries, hunt for hardcoded credentials, identify insecure protocols, and analyse cloud backend communication — producing a full device security report with remediation guidance.
